paragraphs: Personal, free price tracker with a Spanish interface, individual products and shopping baskets. Confirm extracted prices, track history and receive ntfy push and Gmail alerts when your goals are met.
Incomplete readings/conversions block aggregate alerts; estimates stay marked.
escalating from HTTP to browser modes. Shop blocks and currency differences can require confirmation, a recipe or the residential-IP fallback.
features: Products can stand alone or belong to several baskets with quantities/budgets.
Basket totals use decimal arithmetic and dated USD/PEN rates from BCRPData.
Price extraction tries structured data, metadata, owner CSS and heuristics,
React/Vite/TypeScript, Tailwind/shadcn/ui and Recharts provide the dark PWA.
Normal operation: cron-job.org → Actions every 3h, watched by Healthchecks

requirements.text: If App passwords is unavailable under your account policy, that account cannot configure this SMTP path; use an eligible Gmail account rather than its login password.
No CRONJOB API key is needed for console operation.

purchase-cover-v1 uses deterministic depth-first exact cover: choose the uncovered need with fewest candidate alternatives, UUID tie order; enumerate alternatives by UUID, reject overlapping scopes/offer limits, accumulate nonnegative decimal cost.
